video_title: Draymond Green sparks Warriors’ bounce-back win vs. Celtics | NBC Sports Bay Area

quotes.speaker: Bonta Hill
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green's scoring impact on the Warriors' offense
quotes.excerpt: When he scores, it loosens up the defense just a little bit

text_blocks.speaker: Bonta Hill
text_blocks.text: You can't tell me that it doesn't matter when he scores. It does matter when he scores. When he scores, it loosens up the defense just a little bit and he finishes with nine points, all in the first quarter.

text_blocks.speaker: Monte Poole
text_blocks.text: Yeah, he's the one of those nine points in the first six minutes and they never scored again. But he set a tone.

quotes.social_post: Bonta Hill on the impact of Draymond Green scoring early: You cannot tell me it does not matter when he scores. It loosens up the defense and he set a tone for the Warriors in the first quarter.

structured.context: Bonta Hill discusses how Draymond Green setting an early offensive tone impacted the Warriors' performance against the Celtics.

quotes.speaker: Monte Poole
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green's unexpected three-point shooting performance
quotes.excerpt: He took five three-point shots. And so this is a guy who is averaging less than one make per game

text_blocks.speaker: Monte Poole
text_blocks.text: He took five three-point shots. And so this is a guy who is averaging less than one make per game.

text_blocks.speaker: Monte Poole
text_blocks.text: So when you do that and you make them, I think the whole team kind of, oh, okay, that's a nice surprise. Because you don't expect it, but I think Steve Kerr had told him, they had discussed this. Draymond, I'm going to play with Charles Bassey at the five, you're going to be the four, that means corner threes for you. Let them fly.

quotes.social_post: Monte Poole reveals Steve Kerr gave Draymond Green the green light to let it fly from the corner: I think Steve Kerr had told him they had discussed this. Draymond, you are going to be the four, that means corner threes for you.

structured.context: Monte Poole explains that Steve Kerr instructed Draymond Green to take corner three-pointers as part of a tactical adjustment.

quotes.speaker: Dalton Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen Curry's reaction to Draymond Green's three-point shooting
quotes.excerpt: Steph almost fell out of the seat after the third three-pointer
quotes.quote: Those three-pointers from Draymond, the bench was up. Steph almost fell out of the seat after the third three-pointer. It brought the collective energy for the entire team. He came into this game making four threes the entire season, and he made three in the first quarter. I just thought that gave everybody a little bit of life.
quotes.social_post: Draymond Green hitting three pointers in the first quarter brought the energy for the Warriors. Dalton Johnson notes Steph Curry almost fell out of his seat after the third one.

structured.context: Dalton Johnson describes how Stephen Curry and the Warriors bench reacted to Draymond Green's unexpected three-point shooting.

quotes.speaker: Dalton Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green's defensive effort against Jayson Tatum
quotes.excerpt: Green pushed Tatum left and contested a 16-foot fadeaway that missed with 1.6 seconds left
quotes.quote: Green pushed Tatum left and contested a 16-foot fadeaway that missed with 1.6 seconds left. He tries to get him to go left for the final shot. He gets him to go left, Tatum crosses, beats him, but he keeps his feet sliding and has great verticality by Draymond Green.
quotes.social_post: Dalton Johnson breaks down the defensive sequence where Draymond Green forced Jayson Tatum left and used great verticality to contest the final shot of the game.

structured.context: Dalton Johnson analyzes the defensive play where Draymond Green forced Jayson Tatum into a missed shot at the end of the game.
